prompts.TerrainGroundAlbedo20260730: Create a square, seamless, straight-down terrain albedo texture for a premium Three.js historical strategy game set in the Taihang foothills, North China, late autumn 1941. The entire image is only continuous natural ground: warm ochre loess, compact earth, fine limestone gravel, sparse dry straw, tiny weathered pebbles, and very subtle muted olive scrub traces. Realistic PBR-style diffuse color, refined material detail, rich natural micro-variation, restrained period palette. Uniform flat overcast reference lighting with no directional shadows, highlights, ambient occlusion, gradient, vignette, perspective, horizon, or focal point. It must tile perfectly on all four edges. No roads, rails, paths, field boundaries, trenches, footprints, buildings, people, weapons, writing, symbols, logos, watermark, large rocks, or obvious repeated motif. Avoid washed-out gray-green color.

prompts.TerrainPaperHigh20260730:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless square terrain-surface texture for a high-quality Three.js historical strategy map
Primary request: create a production-ready, perfectly tileable 1:1 texture combining aged unbleached field paper with dry North China loess earth. It will be multiplied softly over a warm terrain albedo, so keep contrast restrained and detail evenly distributed.
Style/medium: realistic scanned material texture, tactile paper fibers blended with fine compacted soil, subtle handmade wartime map-document character, not an illustration.
Composition/framing: flat orthographic surface filling the entire square; seamless on all four edges; no focal point, no horizon, no directional lighting, no vignette.
Color palette: muted warm khaki, dusty ochre, desaturated olive-gray and faint charcoal specks; neutral enough for forests, fields, villages and mountain shading to remain readable.
Materials/textures: fine fibrous grain, shallow wrinkles, tiny mineral flecks, restrained stains and micro-cracks; broad variation must be very soft and non-repeating.
Constraints: no text, no calligraphy, no symbols, no map lines, no roads, no rivers, no hexagons, no buildings, no people, no objects, no border, no watermark; avoid harsh creases, black blotches, obvious repeating motifs, strong shadows or glossy highlights. High-resolution game-ready material texture.
